**Viswanadham (Vish) Sridhara, PhD**

[Download CV (PDF)](Vish_Sridhara_Bioinformatics.pdf){.btn .btn-primary download="Vish_Sridhara_CV.pdf"}

::: {.cv-lead}
Bioinformatics Solutions Architect with 10+ years designing scalable NGS pipelines across **biotech, consulting, and federal organizations**, including NIH and FDA.

- Experienced in **bulk / single-cell RNA-seq, cloud workflows**, and data delivery across **AWS** and **Azure**.
- Customized nf-core/airrflow for a **3 TB, 2B+ sequence antibody dataset**, generating ESM-2-ready inputs; enhanced AWS/Snakemake analytics across **12,500+ datasets**.
- Applied AI/ML to life-sciences data using **PyTorch, TensorFlow, and MLflow**.
- Author of **20+ peer-reviewed publications**, with 1,000+ citations and an h-index of 15.
:::

## Architecture and Technical Capabilities

<div class="cv-skills">
<div class="k">Bioinformatics & Computing</div><div>Nextflow, Snakemake, NGS pipelines, bulk/scRNA-seq, proteomics, HPC</div>
<div class="k">Programming & ML</div><div>Python (pandas, NumPy), R, SQL, Bash, PyTorch, TensorFlow, PySpark, MLflow</div>
<div class="k">Cloud & Data</div><div>AWS EC2/S3, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Git, CI/CD, regulated data environments</div>
<div class="k">Data Architecture & Engineering</div><div>Data platforms, Scalable pipelines, ETL/ELT, Workflow orchestration</div>
<div class="k">Solution Delivery</div><div>Rally, Requirements translation, Stakeholder collaboration, Technical documentation</div>
</div>

## Work Experience

::: {.cv-job}
### Independent Bioinformatics Consultant
<div class="cv-meta"><span>Self-employed</span><span class="when">Jan 2026 – Present</span></div>

- Streamline NGS data processing through reproducible workflows using **Python, R, and Nextflow**.
- Develop cloud **data platform** projects covering data ingestion, transformation, security, and monitoring.
:::

::: {.cv-job}
### Senior Bioinformatics Scientist (part-time)
<div class="cv-meta"><span>Argentys Informatics · Remote</span><span class="when">Jul 2022 – Feb 2025 · Aug 2025 – Dec 2025</span></div>

- Designed and deployed a **scalable and reproducible bioinformatics pipeline** (variant of nf-core airrflow) for antibody repertoire analysis using Observed Antibody Space Database (2B+ sequences, 3TB scale).
- Partnered with domain experts to translate ambiguous research questions into **well-scoped data science deliverables**.
- Generated **model-ready antibody repertoires** (lineage trees) for ingestion into downstream protein language model based AI workflows (ESM2 and related models).
:::

::: {.cv-job}
### Bioinformatics Scientist (contract)
<div class="cv-meta"><span>Twist Bioscience · SFO, CA</span><span class="when">Mar 2025 – Jul 2025</span></div>

- Improved an **end-to-end zero-shot inference pipeline** to predict antibody fitness and developability, defining evaluation metrics and validation strategies for robust, repeatable variant ranking.
- Worked extensively with **PyTorch** and **TensorFlow** models for training, evaluation, benchmarking, and deployment-ready inference (MLflow, AWS, Databricks).
:::

::: {.cv-job}
### Software Engineer (full-time)
<div class="cv-meta"><span>Protein Metrics LLC (Dotmatics/Siemens) · Remote</span><span class="when">Apr 2021 – Jul 2023</span></div>

- Developed command-line tools and **automated test suites** to support Byos applications.
- Supported analytics-driven software releases by executing **QA testing and creating customer-facing release notes** and product documentation in collaboration with engineering and product teams.
:::

::: {.cv-job}
### Senior Bioinformatics Scientist (contract)
<div class="cv-meta"><span>FDA · Silver Spring, MD</span><span class="when">Jan 2019 – Apr 2021</span></div>

- Built an **RNA-seq pipeline for bulk processing** of large-scale genomics datasets using fastp, HISAT2, featureCounts, and DESeq2.
- Developed a **single-cell RNA-seq pipeline** prototype for analyzing 10X datasets using CellRanger, SAVER, Seurat/Monocle, fastMNN, and R packages.
- Characterized **immune-driven drug hypersensitivity** using single-cell RNA sequencing technologies.
:::

::: {.cv-job}
### Bioinformatics Software Developer (full-time)
<div class="cv-meta"><span>Booz Allen Hamilton · Rockville, MD</span><span class="when">Mar 2018 – Nov 2018</span></div>

- Developed PAT's **cloud-based genomics pipeline** using AWS S3, EC2, Snakemake, R, and Python to preprocess NCBI GEO data, including RNA-seq alignment, for on-demand analytics.
- Improved analytics for differential expression, gene ontology and pathway analysis for the PAT tool (**>12,500 datasets** including ~20 RNA-seq projects and ~300 microarray projects).
:::

::: {.cv-job}
### Bioinformatics Consultant (part-time)
<div class="cv-meta"><span>Remote</span><span class="when">Apr 2016 – Apr 2018</span></div>

- Protein Metrics Inc (Dec 2017 – Mar 2019): Testing Protein Metrics suite of tools.
- Mass General Hospital (Apr 2016 – Jul 2017): Improved primer design for a proof-of-principle **assay to capture long genomic regions**. Resulted in Nature Biomedical Engineering and other publications.
:::

::: {.cv-job}
### Research Eng/Sci. Associate IV (full-time)
<div class="cv-meta"><span>The University of Texas at Austin</span><span class="when">Jan 2012 – Apr 2016</span></div>

- Worked on **Army Research Office MURI grant** (multi-university incl. BU, Harvard) to build mathematical models to **infer associations in multi-omics data (ML work)**. Resulted in multiple high-impact publications.
- Taught computational mass-spectrometry course in Big Data Summer School organized by CCBB (Center for Computational Biology and Bioinformatics) every summer – 4 day course.
:::
